Agentic product workshop / Introduction

Build one complete product slice

A three-part workshop for framing a real task, building the smallest complete experience, and reviewing the rendered result.

The outcome

Participants leave with a working product slice and a repeatable way to frame, build, inspect, and review similar work.

Agenda

  1. Frame the task09:00–09:30

    Choose one real outcome, a useful reference, and observable acceptance checks.

  2. Build lab09:30–11:15

    Compose one complete path from existing project components.

  3. Review and next step11:15–12:00

    Inspect the result across target sizes and name what should happen next.

Bring one real task

Prepare. Bring a scoped product change, one reference, and a short acceptance checklist. The workshop supplies the method, not placeholder work.

Workshop illustration is illustrative, not product evidence.
